reuse.why: Extends the existing shared definitions, getDateWithSkippedWeekend for moving occurrences and recurConfigToExcludedRules for daily skipping, rather than adding new holiday logic beside them.

duplication.why: No logic block is copied; the only repetition is that each of the five getDateWithSkippedWeekend callers must thread holidays separately, and the helper repeats its unknown-mode throw in two branches.

placement.why: The rule changes land in shared/schedules.ts where the weekend rule lives, with the type in types/models/schedule.ts and the parse path in rule-utils.

scope.why: Every edit serves holiday handling; no unrelated changes.

maintainability.why: The core loop is clear, but the invalid-solve-mode branch is convoluted, the margin formula (3 + 3 per holiday) is an ad hoc heuristic, and holidays is a separate argument every caller must remember (schedule-template reads it from schedule.data while it reads the mode from value), instead of passing the config to the helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All call sites go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend and recurConfigToExcludedRules.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the holiday rule is added inside the shared helpers.

one_place.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend (move) and recurConfigToExcludedRules (daily skip) in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts; every path uses them, though each caller has to pass holidays explicitly.
